svg.title: PNEUMA pipeline metro map
svg.desc: Tube-map overview of the PNEUMA pipeline. A blue QC and host removal trunk (cat, Porechop_ABI, nanoq, NanoPlot, SeqKit stats, Hostile) reaches the Kraken2 interchange which branches into Abundance (Bracken, KrakenTools combine, Krona), Contamination (Recentrifuge), Functional profiling (Tag reads, ABRicate, CARD, VFDB, PlasmidFinder) and a Pathogen reconstruction line. A sky-blue Genomic context line, on by default, branches from the Functional line after ABRicate and runs below it: hit reads, geNomad, ARG context (read calls), then local assembly (read recruitment, Flye meta, contig typing with ABRicate, geNomad and MOB-suite, extend context) and ends at the context tables. A dashed sky-blue Mobilome branch splits off after contig typing: plasmid drafts, Medaka, ISEScan with IS flanks and composite transposons, and plasmid units clustered across samples. The first three end at a vertical junction interchange, from which the downstream line (MERIDIAN, then the Report) and a grey exit to MultiQC (report of all steps) leave; filled stops mark the stations whose output MultiQC reports. The pathogen line is an opt-in line that runs per sample and panel species: read extraction, a coverage gate (with patient-level pooling when no sample passes), Flye and Medaka, CheckM2 and QUAST, skani species confirmation, MLST, AMRFinderPlus, ABRicate and Bakta (MOB-suite optional), ending in the Pathogen report; QUAST, CheckM2 and the pathogen status are reported in MultiQC. On the genomic context line, Extend context (the final context per sample) and Plasmid units are reported in MultiQC.

text.tspan: PNEUMA: ONT metagenomics for low-biomass respiratory samples
